atAGlance: Cua rang muối is salt-roasted crab, usually with garlic, chili, salt crust, and sweet crab meat.
whatItIs: Cua rang muối is crab tossed with salt, chili, garlic, and aromatics until the shell carries a dry savory crust.
howToEnjoy: Crack the shell, taste the salty crust, then use lime-pepper dip lightly. It is a slow shared plate, not a tidy one-person order.
howLocalsOrder: Order cua rang muối as a shared crab plate. Ask for less chili before the crab is tossed, and ask for shell crackers if the shop has them.
worthKnowing: Rang muối is a favorite Vietnamese seafood style because the seasoning clings to the shell and perfumes your fingers as you eat.
